The Leaky Integrate and Fire (LIF) Model

\[ \tau_m \frac{d}{dt} v(t) = -(v(t) - v_{rest}) + I(t) \\ \text{if } v(t) > v_{thresh}, \text{then } v(t) \leftarrow v_{reset} \]

Parameters:

  • \(\tau_m\): Membrane time constant

  • \(v_{rest}\): Resting potential

  • \(v_{thresh}\): Spike threshold

  • \(v_{reset}\): Spike threshold

LIF properties

  • Linearly adds up inputs until the membrane potential crosses a threshold, at which point a spike is triggered, and the membrane potential is reset.

  • Spikes are all-or-none assumed to be identical in size and duration.

  • Spikes aren’t actually part of the stimulation. They are just hand drawn in when threshold is crossed.

  • There can be something of a refractory period if the reset potential is set to hyperpolarize the membrane potential.

  • The amplitude of an input is linearly encoded into the frequency of spiking. This is called Class 1 excitability.

The Quadratic Integrate and Fire (QIF) Model

\[ \tau_m \frac{d}{dt} v(t) = (v(t) - v_{rest})^2 + I(t) \\ \text{if } v(t) > v_{\text{thresh}}, \text{then } v(t) \leftarrow v_{\text{reset}} \]

Parameters:

  • \(\tau_m\): Membrane time constant

  • \(v_{rest}\): Resting potential

  • \(v_{thresh}\): Spike threshold (set arbitrarily high)

  • \(c_{reset}\): Reset voltage after spike

The Izhikevich (Iz) Model

\[ \frac{dv}{dt} = k(v - v_{\text{rest}})(v - v_{\text{thresh}}) - u + I \]

\[ \frac{du}{dt} = a(bv - u) \]

\[ \text{if } v \geq v_{\text{peak}}, \quad \begin{cases} v \leftarrow c \\\\ u \leftarrow u + d \end{cases} \]

Iz Parameters

  • \(v\): membrane potential
  • \(u\): recovery variable
  • \(a, b, c, d\): recovery parameters
  • \(k\): curvature of the voltage parabola
  • \(v_{\text{rest}}\): resting potential
  • \(v_{\text{thresh}}\): threshold potential
  • \(v_{\text{peak}}\): spike cutoff/reset threshold
  • \(I\): input current

Why the Izhikevich Model?

  • It is a phenomenological model — built to reproduce complex firing patterns using minimal equations

  • It trades biophysical realism for:

    • A rich repertoire of spiking behaviors

    • Very low computational cost

    • Easy switching between neuron types (just tweak a few parameters)
